Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of UNH.
We generated $8.9 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $47.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
Our gross margin expanded by 50 basis points to 35.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $2.4 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 50 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
